issues.problem: Context 3 (why has the slogan become so 深入人心) fits 家喻户晓 just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it to set reciting the slogan against really believing it, so only 深入人心 fits.

issues.problem: The story is correct (《史记·鲁周公世家》), but the source text has 平易近民, not 平易近人. Context 1 (the new manager is very ...) fits 和蔼可亲 equally well.
issues.action: Kept the story and added a note on the original wording. Context 1 now says the manager holds a high position (虽然职位高，却很平易近人).

issues.problem: The story was checked against 《战国策·楚策一》 and is correct. Contexts 1 and 6 fit 仗势欺人 just as well.
issues.action: Added that the person has no power or ability of their own, which is the point of the fox image.

issues.problem: Misuse 2 (他上课迟到还顶撞老师，真是彬彬有礼) reads naturally as sarcasm, so it is not clearly wrong. Context 4 (boyfriend) fits 落落大方 just as well.
issues.action: Replaced misuse 2 with the idiom used for a tidy room. Context 4 now shows courteous behaviour (greeting the parents and pouring tea).

issues.problem: The reason for misuse 1 was garbled. In misuse 2, using it of a spacious room is doubtful rather than clearly wrong, because 落落大方 can also describe a style or design.
issues.action: Rewrote the reason for misuse 1 (the second half alone means generous; the idiom does not). Replaced misuse 2 with the idiom used to mean a garment is too big and loose.

issues.problem: The story was checked against 《旧唐书·李义府传》 (笑中有刀, 李猫) and is correct. The cue and contexts 1 and 6 stressed warm words, so 口蜜腹剑 fit them just as well.
issues.action: Made the smiling manner explicit in the cue and in contexts 1 and 6.

issues.problem: Context 4 (别旁敲侧击了，有什么话就直说吧) fits 拐弯抹角 just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it so the speaker is being probed for information (their exam score), which is the sense of 旁敲侧击.
